action_items: (Optional/minor) TopDriversWidget on UserHome was not visually confirmed because /user/home route showed admin dashboard when logged in as admin; widget code path + public /api/drivers/top both work, so likely fine, but main agent can self-verify by logging in as a passenger.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py /admin/top-drivers-config GET: returns raw doc {service_key, settings, updated_at, _id-excluded} when doc exists but returns {settings:{...}} wrapper when not. Shape is slightly inconsistent; frontend should always read settings sub-key. Works but could be normalized.

drivers.py /drivers/top composite formula: pts*0.4 + min(trips,500)/5.0*0.4 + rating/5*100*0.2. Max theoretical score = 40+40+20=100. The trips weight caps at 500 trips which is reasonable for VTC; documented as comment for clarity.

admin.py _crud_col stores new collections under prefix 'admin_' (admin_vehicle_makes, admin_sos_requests, ...). This is clean isolation but means DB backup count lists show both the underlying collection and admin_ variants; verify naming conventions are documented.

/admin/db-backup does a list_collection_names + count_documents per collection in a loop. For 50+ collections this is O(N) network calls. Fine today but consider mongo $collStats aggregation if DB grows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 pages visually verified: /top-chauffeurs, /admin/top-drivers, /admin/db-backup, /admin/vehicle-makes, /admin/sos-requests, plus sidebar navigation)
